report.source_text: Treatment commenced, including high-dose methotrexate, cytarabine and rituximab, followed by radiotherapy (40 Gy total). Repeat MRI showed significant improvement in the central nervous system disease (figure 1G–I) and she also improved functionally, being discharged home without a package of care after previously needing 24 h nursing care. Ten months later, functional status had not deteriorated and neuropsychometric testing was equivalent to that done several months prior to commencement of treatment (ie, before significant further cognitive decline), however remaining below premorbid estimates. Importantly, her gait and mobility also improved dramatically as she went from being unable to walk unaided immediately prior to treatment, to walking independently, swimming twice weekly and using a cross-trainer regularly.

clinician.final_diagnosis: Diffuse large B cell lymphoma (Primary CNS Lymphoma)
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 50-year-old lady presented with subacutely progressive amnestic syndrome, personality change, emotional lability, severe anxiety, and insomnia. Initial neurological exam showed brisk reflexes, language difficulty, and apraxia. Brain MRI revealed extensive confluent T2-weighted hyperintensities throughout the cerebrum and brainstem, without mass effect, enhancement, or diffusion restriction. CSF analysis showed elevated protein, normal glucose, <1 WBC/mL, negative oligoclonal bands and viral PCRs, and cytology consistent with a mild chronic inflammatory/reactive process but no atypical cells. A brain biopsy, performed months later, showed diffuse and nodular infiltration of the cerebrum by large atypical lymphoid cells. Further tests confirmed a diffuse large B cell lymphoma. Staging with bone marrow biopsy and PET/CT found no evidence of lymphoma outside the central nervous system, confirming primary CNS lymphoma. Treatment included high-dose methotrexate, cytarabine, rituximab, and radiotherapy. Post-treatment, repeat MRI showed significant improvement, and the patient experienced dramatic functional recovery, including improved mobility and neuropsychometric status.
